intro.en: Medical project cables are engineered as components within the equipment safety and performance system.
intro.zh: 医疗项目电缆作为设备安全与性能体系内的元件进行设计。

knowledge.en: Equipment risk control, applied parts, signals, cleaning, usability and traceability define the cable.
knowledge.zh: 设备风险控制、应用部分、信号、清洁、可用性与追溯共同定义线缆。

notes.en: Provide equipment boundary, circuits, interface, handling, cleaning and validation plan.
notes.zh: 请提供设备边界、回路、接口、操作、清洁与验证计划。

delivery.en: Release records component identity, process, inspection and traceability.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含元件身份、工艺、检验与追溯。

subtitle.en: Engineer the cable inside the equipment risk-control system
subtitle.zh: 把线缆纳入医疗设备风险控制体系

lead.en: Safety and performance belong to the complete equipment system.
lead.zh: 安全与性能属于完整设备系统。
